verdict: Series regen after STU-719/740 canonicalization is a large net win: check_wikilinks.py --series dead links dropped 136->10 and 8 junk/duplicate PERSON pages were correctly removed. Two defect classes remain: (1) a stale-case export artifact leaves BILLINA.wiki out of sync with the now-correct canonical_name 'Billina', producing 10 dead links; (2) 5 series pages carry untranslated French prose inherited verbatim from a single contributing tome's own wiki_pages.json (pre-existing per-tome generation bug, not caused by this PR, previously only visible as an aggregate lang_fr_pct in run 1 and not traced to specific pages). A third, lower-priority class: STU-740's stopword/dedup fix was scoped to PERSON entities and missed the same class of junk in other entity types (locations/His_Majesty, locations/Emperor, events/The) and one unmerged PERSON duplicate (Guardian vs Guardian_of_the_Gates).
new_issues: check_wikilinks.py --series reports 10 dead [[Billina]] links: output/_series/characters/BILLINA.wiki keeps its old all-caps filename even though series_assembly.json's canonical_name for that character is now 'Billina' (fixed by STU-719) - series-export's stateless rebuild (shutil.rmtree + rewrite) did not rename the file, likely a case-insensitive-filesystem artifact (core.ignorecase=true) swallowing the case-only rename. Every other page links it as [[Billina]]. Fix: rename/regenerate so filename matches canonical_name casing, or make series-export's rmtree/write path case-rename-safe.

5 series character pages carry untranslated French paragraphs mixed into an English-declared wiki (export.categories.language: en): characters/Saw-Horse.wiki (tome 2 Biography), characters/Old_Mombi.wiki (tome 4 Biography), characters/Wizard.wiki (tome 5 Biography), characters/Lord_High_Chigglewitz.wiki (tome 6, entire page), characters/Nome_King.wiki (tome 6 Personality + Trivia sections). Traced to each tome's own processing_output/<tome>/wiki_pages.json - the French text is already there, i.e. a wiki-pages generation-stage LLM output that ignored the declared language for isolated items, pre-existing since the original tome runs and not introduced by this PR. Run 1's lang_fr_pct sniff (2.9-5.6% per book 02/04/05/06) already flagged this in aggregate but was never traced to specific pages or filed. Fix: regenerate the affected wiki-pages items (force re-run those specific entities) and consider a post-generation language-verdict check for wiki-pages output, the same shape as the existing per-unit verdict stages.

STU-740's stopword/junk-entity drop was scoped to PERSON entities and missed the same class of junk in other entity types: output/_series/locations/His_Majesty.wiki and output/_series/locations/Emperor.wiki are near-empty junk pages (generic role phrases misclassified as LOCATION), and output/_series/events/The.wiki is a bare stopword title. Also output/_series/characters/Guardian.wiki (tome 2) and characters/Guardian_of_the_Gates.wiki (tome 1) are an unmerged duplicate of the same office/character. Fix: extend the STU-719/740 generic-role/stopword drop beyond PERSON, and merge the Guardian/Guardian of the Gates alias.
